issues.explanation: No migration creates the required queue_access table (FKs with cascade, permissions JSON, timestamps, unique entity_membership_id+queue_id).
QueueAccess sets no $table so Eloquent infers queue_accesses instead of the required queue_access table.

Ticket::call authorizes after the only-waiting-tickets LogicException instead of inactive then authorize then LogicException, so an already-called ticket throws LogicException instead of AuthorizationException.
membership() defaults to membership_id FK instead of the required entity_membership_id column, so the relation is broken.
UpdateQueue only pre-checks slug uniqueness and has no QueryException to ValidationException mapping on save, so a race can leak a raw QueryException.
All actions take User $actor (Ticket::call takes User $user) but call Gate::authorize with ambient auth instead of Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize, so authorization does not follow the passed actor.
Required doc and changelog updates are absent from the diff.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, including required unauthorized-call paths.
Policy mapping is registered twice via AppServiceProvider Gate::policy and a new AuthServiceProvider that may not be registered, adding redundant indirection.
SetQueueAccess checks entity mismatch before manageAccess authorization, lowercases permissions so CALL is accepted, and keeps a dead is_array check under an array type-hint.
QueueAccess imports unused Fillable attribute while using $fillable, and QueuePolicy uses inline App\Models\Entity in the create signature despite importing Entity.
CreateQueue and UpdateQueue do not reject an empty slug after Str::slug, allowing an empty slug to be stored.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:47, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:116 and app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:321 follow Actions-plus-policy pattern and sibling style, but database/migrations/* has no queue_access migration and docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md are untouched

readability.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:44, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:188 and app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:337 are small and clearly named; nits are app/Models/QueueAccess.php:253 unused Fillable import and app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:321 inline App\Models\Entity

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:54 slug/race handling, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:221 no race mapping, app/Models/Ticket.php:95 authorize after LogicException, app/Models/QueueAccess.php:1 wrong inferred table, plus missing database/migrations/* and docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md

scope.evidence: change.diff:1-455 touches only CallNextTicket, CreateQueue, UpdateQueue, SetQueueAccess, QueuePermission, QueueAccess, Ticket::call, QueuePolicy, providers and QueueAccessFactory with no delete action and no unrelated feature

security.evidence: Gate::authorize('create'/'update'/'manageAccess'/'call') present at app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:47, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:191, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:116, app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:18 and app/Models/Ticket.php:95, but all use ambient auth instead of Gate::forUser($actor) and app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:111 validates before authorizing

simplicity.evidence: reuses Str::slug, updateOrCreate at app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:153 and EntityMembershipPolicy::isManagerOf at app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:324; duplication is app/Providers/AuthServiceProvider.php:1 duplicating AppServiceProvider Gate::policy plus dead is_array at app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:119

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-455 contains no tests/* files and no Pest coverage for create/update/access/call happy paths or unauthorized paths

review.summary: The change implements the queue lifecycle, per-queue access grants and policy enforcement on the happy path, but ships no migration or tests, infers the wrong queue_access table with a broken membership relation, orders Ticket::call authorization after the LogicException, misses UpdateQueue race mapping, and authorizes ambient auth instead of the passed actor.
